02. Predictive Modeling, Spatial CV, and Risk Calibration¶

Task A (Occurrence Risk) & Task B (Severity KSI)¶

We evaluate Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers against Prior and Logistic Regression baselines using temporal splits (Train: 2021-2022, Val: 2023, Test: 2024) and 5-fold spatial cross-validation by police force.

Leakage Prevention Audit¶

Task A uses a strict 1:4 case-control design rejecting controls within 500m and ±1 hour, completely excluding subjective post-accident police fields.

Modeling Conclusions¶

Both tree ensembles significantly outperform linear and prior baselines. XGBoost achieves superior Brier score calibration on the relative risk scale.
